title: Beige Grid Daisy Seamless Pattern Bundle
author: Julia's digital designs
description:
Beige Grid Daisy Striped Seamless Patterns — 12 Digital Papers
Enhance your creative projects with this beautiful collection of aesthetic beige grid daisy, plaid and stripes seamless patterns. Inspired by cottagecore and rustic farmhouse vibes, these pastel-toned digital papers are perfect for a wide range of crafts, stationery, and digital designs.
Since these are seamless, you can tile them endlessly without any visible seams or edges!
✨ What’s Included:
12 Seamless Patterns (repeating designs)
Format: High-quality PNG files
Size: 12 x 12 inches (3600 x 3600 pixels)
Resolution: 300 DPI (perfect for crystal-clear printing)
🎨 Perfect For:
Digital scrapbooking and journaling
Planner dividers, stickers, and dashboards
DIY greeting cards, invitations, and stationery
KDP notebook covers and interior backgrounds
Party decorations and gift wrapping paper
Social media backgrounds and web design
Sublimation and crafts
Please note: This is a digital download product. No physical items will be shipped.
